title: HydraScript project configuration
description: Schema for hydraconfig.json. Keys the current runner ignores are still listed, and their description says so, so an editor never promises behaviour the tool does not have.

$schema.description: Points at this file. Editors use it for completion and validation.

name.description: Project name, used in scaffolding output.

base.description: Asset URL prefix. "sub", "/sub" and "/sub/" are equivalent. An absolute URL (a CDN) is kept verbatim.

outputDir.description: Directory the build writes to, relative to the project root.

routes.description: Where the file-based router looks for pages. A string is the directory; `false` turns the router off; an object may carry `dir`. Default `./src/pages`.

mode.description: Overrides the build mode. Usually left to hydra dev / hydra build.

tailwind.description: Merged into the Tailwind configuration. `content` is extended with index.html and src/**, not replaced.

port.description: Port to serve on. `--port N` on dev/preview overrides it.

host.description: Bind address. Defaults to loopback; `--host 0.0.0.0` or this key makes the server reachable from the network.

proxy.description: Path-prefix to backend mapping, matched like Vite's server.proxy. A backend that is down returns 502, not a crash.

bodyLimit.description: Largest request body an API route or action will read, in bytes. Default 1048576 (1 MiB). A bigger body is answered with 413 and `Connection: close`, never a dropped socket.

jsxInJs.description: Treat .js files as JSX. Set false if a .js file in your project contains something esbuild would misread as JSX.

target.description: NOT USED YET. Accepted and validated, but the current runner always compiles for react-18 and does not switch on this value.

strict.description: NOT USED YET. Accepted and validated, but no compile-time semantic checks exist yet, so setting this changes nothing. Do not rely on it to catch mistakes.

ssg.description: Pre-render every static route to its own HTML file. ON by default (the code treats anything but an explicit false as on); `HYDRA_NO_SSG=1` skips it for one build.

sourcemap.description: Emit source maps for the client bundle. OFF by default: a map carries the application's source in `sourcesContent`, and `dist/` is what gets uploaded.

target.description: What the artifact is for. `static` writes HTML/JS/CSS only and does NOT serve src/api or src/middleware.hys (it lists every dropped route at build time). `node` also includes the API routes, middleware, loaders and actions. `hydra build --target` overrides this for one build. There are deliberately only two targets.

clean.description: Empty the output directory before writing. ON by default, so a route deleted from the source stops being served; set false only when the directory holds files this build does not own.

root.description: NOT USED YET. Accepted and validated, but the runner always reads sources from ./src.

entries.description: NOT USED YET. Accepted and validated, but the entrypoint is always the first of src/main.hyx, src/main.hsx, src/index.hyx, src/index.hsx that exists.

styling.description: NOT USED YET. Accepted and validated, but this key is never read; Tailwind is configured through the top-level `tailwind` key.

ssr.description: Set false to disable server rendering of dynamic routes in dev/preview/serve. A dynamic route then answers with the client shell, and `hydra serve` reports why.
